title: Yiɗɓe Goonga Ɓooyɓe
intro: Miijo-ɗee sahaa nde goonɗinal ƴaañii, fedde yontaaji cuɓii ko hoolaare nde ustataako e dow wellitaare aduna. E nder suɓngo hulɓiniingo, ɓe ɗaɓɓi reentaade, ɓe puɗɗii yahdu ndu addani ɓe ɗaanaade no feewi. Daartol maɓɓe ko seedantaagal ndeenka Alla e doole iimanaagal e tooñannge. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude hol ko woni ɓeeɗoo yimɓe teskinaaɓe ?
clues: Min ngonnoo ko dental tokosal, min kawri ko e goongɗinal luggiɗngal e Tagɗo gooto.
En nguurii e jamaanu mo laamɗo doole ina ɗaɓɓa dewal goɗɗum ko wonaa Alla.
Ngam hisnude iimanaagal amen, min pelliti woppude galleeji amen, min ndoga e tooñannge.
Sehil lolluɗo, tagoore leydi, yahdi e amen e yahdu amen.
En tawii sanctuaire e nokku keeriiɗo, ɗo Alla waɗi en naatde e ɗanngal luggiɗngal, juutngal.
Nde min njippii, min cikkatnoo ko ñalawma gooto walla feccere ñalawma tan ɓenni, kono ko goonga teeminanɗe ɓennii.

verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
